name: Command and Control Infrastructure
description: Ability to design, deploy, and operate command and control (C2) infrastructure for red team operations. Covers C2 framework selection and configuration, redirector architecture, malleable profiles, operational security of infrastructure, and resilient multi-channel communications.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the role of C2 in red team operations and can name common frameworks
evidence: Can explain the purpose of redirectors, beacons, and listeners
Understands why C2 infrastructure operational security matters

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Deploys and operates basic C2 infrastructure under supervision
evidence: Deployed a C2 framework (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mythic) in lab environment
Configured basic listeners and generated payloads under guidance
Set up a single-tier HTTP/HTTPS redirector using Apache or Nginx with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently deploys resilient C2 infrastructure for standard engagements
evidence: Built and operated C2 infrastructure for 3+ live engagements
Configured malleable profiles or traffic shaping to blend with target environment
Deployed multi-tier redirector architecture with proper OPSEC
Managed C2 infrastructure lifecycle including teardown and evidence preservation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Designs advanced C2 architectures for evasive operations against mature defenders
evidence: Designed C2 infrastructure that evaded network monitoring in defended environments
Implemented CDN-fronted, cloud-native or SaaS-API C2 channels, treating classic domain fronting as historical since major CDNs disabled it
Built automated infrastructure-as-code deployment for C2 setups
Mentors team on C2 infrastructure design and operational security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Develops novel C2 techniques; contributes to C2 frameworks; defines lab standards
evidence: Developed custom C2 implants or communication protocols
Contributed to open-source or commercial C2 frameworks
Published research on C2 techniques or infrastructure design
Defines and maintains the lab's C2 infrastructure standards and playbooks

assessment_methods.description: Deploy a full C2 infrastructure with redirectors, malleable profile, and HTTPS listener in a lab environment within a time constraint
Review infrastructure diagrams and configurations from recent engagements for OPSEC and resilience
